name: rosetta-make-directory-path
code:
use IO.Std.write_line

mkdir_p(path: string) is
    let parts = path.split(['/'])
    let built mut = ""

    for part in parts do
        built = if built =~ "" then part else "{built}/{part}" fi

        if !IO.Directory.exists(built) then
            IO.Directory.create_directory(built)
        fi
    od
si

mkdir_p("depth/one/two")
IO.Directory.create_directory("builtin/one/two")

write_line("{IO.Directory.exists("depth/one/two")}")
write_line("{IO.Directory.exists("builtin/one/two")}")

mkdir_p("depth/one/two")
write_line("{IO.Directory.exists("depth/one/two")}")

IO.Directory.delete("depth", true)
IO.Directory.delete("builtin", true)
